servinfo.title: Clearance light(s), tail light(s) or license plate light(s) does not light up

condition.ptxt: Clearance light(s), tail light(s) or license plate light(s) does not light up

ps.ptxt: Faulty system circuit (including relays and fuses)

action.ptxt: Repair circuit and replace relay and/or fuse.

ps.ptxt: Faulty lighting and turn signal switch

action.ptxt: Refer to Lighting and Turn Signal Switch Inspection .
Refer to Inspection of BCM and Its Circuits .

ps.ptxt: Faulty headlight unit / license plate light (LED type) / rear combination light

action.ptxt: If the above are all normal, replace headlight unit / license plate light (LED type) / rear combination light.
